errors: No arithmetic slip once the transcription is corrected: 4+4+1+3+1+3 = 16 and 4+12 = 16.

The count is heuristic. Equality of the number of unknowns and equations proves neither solvability nor uniqueness. Independence of the 16 conditions is not argued, nor is the possible redundancy of parameters under Möbius normalisation of the parameter plane. This is typical of Riemann's style and not an error per se.

Requiring the vertex positions implicitly fixes the edge directions, and hence which great circles occur (each must be perpendicular to its edge). Riemann counts only 'is a great circle' as 4 conditions. Consistency with the edge directions is presumably meant to follow from the vertex conditions together with the structure of the formulas; the page does not spell this out.

results.what: Parameter count: 16 real constants vs 16 conditions (4 great-circle conditions + 12 vertex conditions) for the minimal surface spanning a skew quadrilateral via the Gauss map / Weierstrass representation.
results.modern_name: Constant counting for the Plateau problem for a skew quadrilateral (Schwarz–Riemann minimal surface) via Gauss map and Schwarz–Christoffel / hypergeometric-type ODE
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (posthumous memoir, Hattendorff ed. 1867) and H. A. Schwarz (1865, skew quadrilateral)

results.what: Straight boundary lines map under the Gauss map to great circles, i.e. circles in the stereographic η-plane with r^2 = 1+|c|^2.
results.modern_name: Gauss image of a straight boundary line of a minimal surface is a great circle (Schwarz reflection setting)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working note (insertion 'zu Seite 42') to Riemann's known, posthumously published minimal-surface memoir. It contains a parameter count of the kind found in that memoir. There are no new results.

checkable.asserts: Number of free real constants listed equals 16 (with 'je eine additive Constante' = 3).
Number of conditions: 4 great-circle conditions plus 3 coordinates at 4 vertices.
A circle with r^2 = 1+|c|^2 is invariant under the antipodal map eta -> -1/conj(eta), i.e. it is the stereographic image of a great circle (one real condition per circle).

transcription_corrections: 'in $du$ und $ds$[?] neun[?] additive Constanten' should read 'in $du$ und je eine additive Constante in $x, y, z$'. That is three additive constants, not nine, and there is no 'ds'; otherwise the count would not total 16.
'{+reelle+}' is an interlinear insertion above 'unbestimmte' and is correctly rendered as an addition: 'unbestimmte reelle Constanten'.
Final word: 'gegebene Werthe haben' is confirmed.
